steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0090_morphology_generator_diversity_test branch from main and create worktree.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify all 7 dependency tasks are completed (t0024, t0078, t0080, t0081, t0083, t0086, t0088).

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create task folder structure including code/, assets/library/, assets/answer/, results/images/, data/different_morphologies/, data/similar_morphologies/.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review existing papers on DSGC morphology, asymmetry (Schachter 2010, Trenholm 2013, Briggman 2011), procedural morphology generators (Cuntz TREES 2010), and Rall's law.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for current morphology generator libraries (TREES toolbox, NeuroMaC, NeuroMorpho.Org), NEURON Python idioms for procedural section building, and von Mises sampling for branch angles.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0024 Bed B port for de Rosenroll morphology layout, t0080 v3 substrate parameter encoding, t0083 Pareto archive structure, t0086/t0088 biological_priors and biological_scorecard frameworks for re-use in Phase G.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesise research findings into plan/plan.md with all 11 mandatory sections; specify generator API, file structure, validation triplet design, Bed-B reproducibility procedure.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Implement procedural DSGC morphology generator (14 params); generate 30 different + 30 similar morphologies; verification simulation per morphology; visualisation; Bed-B reproducibility check; validation bundle (S-0088-02 + S-0086-02 + S-0088-01); produce library and answer assets.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed visualisation charts; cover all task requirements.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Formulate suggestions.json based on findings; specifically what t0091 should leverage from the generator and validation triplet.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators; capture session transcripts; update task.json status to completed; PR + premerge + merge.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: implementation-focused task (write-library + data-analysis); creative-thinking does not apply.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Skipped: this task produces a generator library and 60 morphology specs, not quantitative metrics comparable to published results. Phase G validation triplet is its own analysis, not literature comparison.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Skipped: local 64-core CPU only. Phase G.2 NMDA units calibration may run on Vast.ai but is small enough to use a single short-lived machine handled inline if needed.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Skipped: no remote machines provisioned via setup-machines step.
